Name: SFG's Crab Monster Recolors (Content Patcher)
Author: ShotFromGuns
Description:
[size=5]New in 1.2.0[/size]

Medium option! Not as subtle as Subtle; nowhere near as obvious as Obvious.

[size=5]About[/size]

Are you sick of flinching every time you run into a crab monster in the mines? Wouldn't it be great if you could spot them when you're paying attention—or even have them be blatantly obvious?

This Content Patcher pack allows you to pick from several settings for each type of crab:

[list]
[*][b]Off:[/b] The mod will not do anything to that crab. It works exactly as if you didn't have the mod installed.
[*][b]Original:[/b] Vanilla design. This is the same as the default sprite, so there's no difference between "Off" and "Original," unless you've installed another mod that's overwritten the crab's default appearance.
[*][b]Subtle:[/b] A minor recolor. The shell looks [i]almost[/i] like the default sprite, but the CMYK values have been slightly shifted. You have to be paying attention to notice a crab.
[*][b]Medium:[/b] Think "Subtle" is too subtle? The CMYK values are shifted a bit farther. You still have to be paying attention to notice a crab, but it's a bit easier, especially if it's not right next to a rock.
[*][b]Obvious:[/b] A major recolor. The shell's colors have been flipped pretty much to the opposite side of the color wheel. There's no way you won't spot every single crab.
[/list]
[size=5]How to Install[/size]

[list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of [b]SMAPI[/b][/url].
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Install [b]Content Patcher[/b][/url].
[*][b]Download[/b] this mod, and [b]unzip[/b] it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley\Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
[size=5]How to Customize[/size]

[list=1]
[*][b]Run the game using SMAPI[/b] at least once to generate a [b]config.json[/b] file.
[*]With the game closed, [b]open config.json[/b] in a simple text editor.
[*]For each crab, [b]change[/b] the value from the default to whichever version you want ([b]Original [/b]or [b]Subtle[/b] or [b]Medium[/b] or [b]Obvious[/b]; or [b]Off[/b] if you don't want the mod to do anything at all)
[*][b]Save your changes[/b] to the config.json file.
[*][b]Run the game using SMAPI[/b], and you should see crab monsters with the coloring you've specified.
[/list]
Repeat steps 2–5 anytime you want to make a change.

[size=5]How to Uninstall[/size]

Delete the mod's folder from [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley\Mods[/font].

(If you want to temporarily disable the mod without completely uninstalling it, you could instead set every crab to [b]Off[/b].)

[size=5]Compatibility[/size]

This mod should have zero compatibility issues, except with other mods that change the appearance of crab monsters.

It can be made compatible with mods that change the appearance of crab monsters by selecting the [b]Off[/b] value for any crab where you want to use the other mod's appearance.

[size=5]Accessibility[/size]

Are you colorblind? Do you want to help me ensure this mod works for people with your type of colorblindness? Send me feedback!
